g.text: Data flow: building and publishing the documentation site
npm run build, with repository links at
docs.php writes 1 page per trait or class
into a section per context, such as
region of each section's README.md, and
the option and tag tables of
a GitHub blob or tree URL at the ref
[it names no file in the repository]
throw, naming the link and the page
bundle the theme with the overrides in
check every page link and anchor,
and throw on a broken one
the static site and its search index
Jest unit tests, then CSpell over
every page under docs/content/ but the
generated pages and index regions, plus
axe on every page against WCAG A and AA,
in light and dark, at desktop and phone width,
then the search box and the mobile menu
[Docs job, with the Netlify secrets set]
deploy docs/build/ to Netlify: the development
site on a push to main, a preview otherwise
[Release docs, on a tag push or a manual run]
built from the tag or branch it checked out
